hardware: 2x Radeon AI PRO R9700 gfx1201, isolated one measurement process per GPU
algorithms: Register and hybrid GPU source plus public entrypoint are byte-identical to released121e. Only host selection changed; fifteen hybrid configuration presets.

protocol.rounds: 9 paired rounds, increased to16 for flushed-single cold weights
protocol.metrics: Median captured GPU-event us, hot and read-evicted B with warm A; conditioning outside timing. Auto latency is sqrt(hot*rotating). Distinct configurations measured once per paired block, shared configurations deduplicated.
protocol.operands: Synthetic E4M3 FP8 activations and independently decoded random MXFP4/E8M0 operands. Benchmark checks up to32x64 sampled output entries against independently decoded FP32 GEMM, plus changed-input replay and storage guards. Public API tests check full outputs, including E5M2/grouped and BF16/FP16.
protocol.development: All3267prior shapes plus two384-shape cohorts are consumed development (4035total). Unchanged selections reuse historical paired blocks; all modified choices have fresh paired measurements. No cross-block ratio or imputed timing.
protocol.reserved: Final192shapes/16new N,K pairs declared before v3 edits, seed46120261113, plus12 targeted five/seven-unroll probes declared before timing. Frozen source and declared gate precede all final reserved timing; no retuning after final results. Both earlier384-shape cohorts are retained as consumed development, not claimed as independent.
protocol.limitations: Point estimates, not confidence bounds or proof of global optimality. Hot/rotating can trade wins; remaining losses against original are reported. No new hardware-counter attribution or new full serving/GSM8K run.

isa_scope: Executed final-selected configuration ELF identities were matched byte-for-byte against their specialization cache. The benchmark and ISA loader use the released reference entrypoint with explicit configurations from the frozen selector plans; GPU files and entrypoint are byte-identical to the final package. Final public API tests separately exercise the refined dispatch.

freeze.consumed: Both prior384-shape cohorts retained as development; v2 failed versus-release performance gate; rejected configurations and ISA retained.

development.scope: Exploratory cached paired blocks, all development; no timing prediction or imputation

rejected_v2_freeze.consumed: independent (384shapes) retained; both measured and rejected hypotheses remain development

qwen_dispatch_equivalence.scope: All M1..8192 for Qwen TP1/TP2 decoder families, rotating policy at measured R9700 capacities. E4M3 checked; E5M2 shares the same non-grouped branch; grouped unchanged.

model_smoke.scope: Fresh TP1 OpenAI-server request with default graphs and frozen refined kernel package

model_scope: Qwen TP1 and TP2 retain exactly the released121e rotating-policy configurations for all49152queries each. Entry point and GPU code unchanged. Historical TP1 serving/GSM8K and unresolved TP2 outlier remain historical; source equivalence is not a fresh accuracy or throughput measurement.
records_scope: Per-shape records below use balanced auto policy; all policies have aggregate summaries and explicit worst cases above. Raw per-policy records remain in the local experiment artifact.
